checklist.item: Visit https://hackenproof.com/programs/smardex-smart-contracts and extract exact in-scope contracts, repos, deployment addresses, and report formatting rules.
Clone the official SmarDex Solidity repositories for Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, BSC and Base deployments.
Run agents/deep_dive_audit.py against the core factory, router, pair and staking contracts with Slither, Mythril, Halmos and Aderyn enabled.
Manually review all admin, owner and timelock functions for missing access-control checks or privilege escalation paths.
Audit oracle, TWAP and price-feed usage for manipulation, staleness and trust assumptions.
Inspect swap, add/remove liquidity and fee-distribution flows for reentrancy, integer issues and broken invariants.
Validate any findings against live on-chain deployments and recent transaction history.
Prepare a Hackenproof submission containing contract addresses, minimal PoC, severity rating and reproduction steps.
